data.title: Vitalik Says Digital Minimalism Can Reduce Reliance on Social Media and the Internet in the AI Era
data.description:
Vitalik shared an essay titled “Digital Minimalism” on X, arguing that people should reconsider their relationship with digital tools as AI develops. According to Odaily, he said users should decide when and how to use digital services rather than be guided by social media algorithms, mobile internet and complex website interfaces.

Vitalik described three steps he has taken: using Firefly to manage X, Bluesky, Farcaster and Lens instead of relying on X’s native interface; keeping his phone in airplane mode by default for 100 consecutive days and connecting through Wi-Fi only when needed; and using command-line tools for tasks involving ENS, IPFS and privacy protocols rather than completing them through websites.

He said traditional websites and web applications can pose privacy risks and require users to trust their servers each time they visit. In his view, modular tools, local applications and AI can let people use natural language to perform tasks that previously required programming knowledge, reducing reliance on closed platforms and complex interfaces. He called the approach “digital minimalism” and said advances in AI, offline applications and software tools are making it possible to rely less on social media, the internet and web applications.

data.title: Flap Founder Says Risk Is Limited to Users Who Connected Wallets or Signed Approvals on Rogue Site
data.description:
Flap’s founder addressed the impact of an incident involving an irregularity with the project’s official website domain. According to ChainCatcher, the risk is limited to users who visited the abnormal site in the tens of minutes before the announcement and connected a wallet or signed an authorization. Users who had previously connected to the FLAP website normally are unaffected and do not need to change their wallet addresses.

The founder said FLAP does not store users’ private keys, seed phrases, or wallet data on its backend. Users should avoid the official website until the issue is resolved; the team will announce when it is back online through its official accounts. Users who recently connected a wallet on the abnormal site can contact the founder by direct message for assistance.

data.title: Nvidia-Backed Baseten Starts $2 Billion Funding Round at Up to $30 Billion Valuation
data.description: AI inference company Baseten has begun raising $2 billion in a new funding round at a valuation of up to $30 billion, with existing investor Sands Capital expected to lead. According to Odaily, Baseten was founded in 2019 and provides enterprises with a platform to deploy and run AI models. The company raised $1.5 billion in June at a $13 billion valuation. Competitor Fireworks AI raised $1.5 billion in July at a $17.5 billion valuation. Nvidia invested $150 million in Baseten in January.

data.title: Ondo Expands Smart Portfolio Lineup to Solana
data.description: Ondo has expanded its smart portfolio product line to Solana. According to Foresight News, all seven portfolios are now available to eligible investors outside the United States and can be traded through major Solana wallets and apps. Three portfolios use strategies developed for Ondo by BlackRock, while the other four are Ondo-designed on-chain portfolios built around popular market themes, including large-cap technology companies and AI.

data.title: Axios Reporter Used Media Coverage to Wage Psychological Warfare; Nuclear Issue Was Not on Agenda, Iranian Media Claims
data.description: According to Jin10, Tasnim News Agency accused Israeli journalist and Axios reporter Barak Ravid, whom it described as a prominent member of Israel's military Unit 8200, of publishing multiple reports early today to wage psychological warfare against Iran. Tasnim said Ravid portrayed U.S.-Iran talks as continuing while amplifying the possibility of U.S. military action, seeking to present “now” as the best and last chance for an agreement. The agency also said Ravid claimed Tehran had asked Washington to lift its maritime blockade to allow negotiations to continue, while Washington required nuclear concessions to resume dialogue. However, according to statements by Iranian officials, the nuclear issue was not part of the current round of indirect talks with the United States.

data.title: BOJ ETF Sales Acceleration Could Support Takaichi’s Spending Agenda
data.description: The Bank of Japan’s decision to speed up sales of exchange-traded funds could increase its payments to the government, potentially helping Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi finance her policy agenda, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Japanese Listed Iole Plans to Sell All 151.21 Bitcoin, Expects 254 Million Yen Loss
data.description: Japanese listed company Iole plans to sell all 151.21 Bitcoin it holds, expecting a loss of about 254 million yen. According to Odaily, the company plans to sell on the market through cryptocurrency exchanges from October 30 through the end of November, possibly in installments. Iole intends to prioritize using the proceeds for AI data centers, AI computing services and its Neo Cloud business. The company said it will continue holding Hyperliquid (HYPE), which it began acquiring in July 2026.

data.title: Bitcoin White Paper's 18th Anniversary Tests Decentralization as Wall Street Embraces Crypto
data.description:
Bitcoin’s white paper was published on October 31, 2008, proposing a peer-to-peer electronic payment system that did not rely on banks or central authorities. According to Odaily, Bitcoin has since developed from a fringe experiment associated with darknet markets and online forums into an asset class embraced by Wall Street and institutional investors; its price is hovering near $80,000 and is on track for its worst month since June.

BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF has reached about $66 billion in size, several publicly traded companies have added Bitcoin to their balance sheets, and traditional financial institutions are expanding into stablecoins, asset tokenization and blockchain financial infrastructure. This adoption contrasts with Bitcoin’s original aim of challenging centralized finance.

Bitcoin also saw $19 billion in leveraged positions liquidated in a single day last October. The 2022 crypto winter erased more than $2 trillion in digital-asset market value.

data.title: World Liberty (WLFI) Adviser Ogle Shares Alert on Suspected Attacks at Kintsu, Flap and StonkBrokers
data.description: World Liberty (WLFI) adviser Ogle shared a Blockaid security alert advising users to avoid the affected websites and not connect their wallets for now. According to Odaily, Blockaid detected an active front-end attack linked to the StepDrainer toolkit involving Kintsu, Flap and StonkBrokers. Malicious scripts were injected into the affected sites, and users who click “Connect Wallet” may be redirected to pages designed to steal assets. Blockaid is investigating and gathering information, with further updates expected.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Rubio and Brazil’s Foreign Minister Agree to Meet Amid Election Tensions
data.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s foreign minister agreed to meet in the coming weeks after US President Donald Trump’s decision to grant refuge to defeated right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro inflamed tensions, according to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter.

data.title: Flap Says Website Hit by DNS Hijacking, Warns Users Not to Connect Wallets
data.description: Flap said on X that its official website was experiencing a DNS hijacking incident and redirecting visitors to an unauthorized site. According to Odaily, the team urged users not to visit the website, connect wallets, or sign transactions while it addresses the issue, and said it would provide an update once the site is confirmed safe.

data.title: U.S. Spot Solana ETFs Post $10.742 Million in Net Outflows on October 30
data.description: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded net outflows of $10.742 million on October 30. According to Odaily, citing SoSoValue data, Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) had the largest outflow at $9.2561 million, while its cumulative historical net inflows totaled $1.123 billion. Morgan Stanley Solana Trust (MSOL) recorded $768,400 in net outflows and $43.1139 million in cumulative historical net inflows. At the time of the report, the ETFs had total net assets of $1.399 billion, a SOL net asset ratio of 2.49%, and cumulative historical net inflows of $1.469 billion.

data.title: U.S. XRP and ZEC Spot ETFs Record $5.0679 Million Combined Net Outflow
data.description:
U.S. spot XRP and ZEC ETFs recorded combined net outflows of $5.0679 million on October 30. According to Odaily, citing SoSoValue data, XRP ETFs had a net outflow of $496,500, while ZEC ETFs saw $4.5714 million in net outflows.

Canary XRP ETF (XRPC) recorded a net inflow of $922,000, bringing its cumulative inflows to $485 million. Grayscale XRP Trust ETF (GXRP) had a net outflow of $725,000, with cumulative inflows of $145 million. As of the report, XRP spot ETFs had $1.419 billion in net assets, a net asset ratio of 1.79%, and cumulative inflows of $1.809 billion.

Zcash ETF (ZCSH) was the only ZEC ETF to record an outflow, totaling $4.5714 million. Its cumulative inflows stood at $222 million. ZEC spot ETFs had $725 million in net assets, a net asset ratio of 3.45%, and cumulative inflows of $222 million.

data.title: China Factory Activity Contracts in October as Growth Recovery Wavers
data.description: China’s factory activity contracted in October, adding to challenges for policymakers seeking to sustain an economic recovery and meet this year’s growth target, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Hyperliquid Whales Hold $8.05B in Positions as Long-Short Ratio Stands at 0.86
data.description:
Whale positions on Hyperliquid total $8.05 billion, with a long-short position ratio of 0.86. According to ChainCatcher, CoinGlass data show that long positions total $3.72 billion, or 46.18%, while short positions total $4.33 billion, or 53.82%. Long positions have a profit of $90.96 million, while short positions have a loss of $68.74 million.

The whale address 0x5b5d..60 holds a 5x cross-margin short position in ETH opened at $2,322.73, with an unrealized profit of $7.96 million.

data.title: A16z-Linked Address Transfers 118,016 HYPE to Trading Firms Over Two Days
data.description: An address linked to a16z, HYPE’s largest external holder, transferred 118,016 HYPE in batches to Wintermute, Galaxy Digital and Cumberland. According to Foresight News, monitoring by @ai_9684xtpa showed the transfers began yesterday and averaged $90.72 per token; their purpose is unknown, and the latest transfer occurred 10 hours ago.

data.title: Morgan Stanley Buys the Dip, Acquiring About 1,302 Bitcoin Through MSBT
data.description: Morgan Stanley spent more than $100 million to acquire about 1,302 BTC through its spot Bitcoin ETF, MSBT, earlier this morning, about seven hours ago. According to Odaily, Arkham data showed the purchase brought the firm's total Bitcoin holdings to 10,850 BTC.

data.title: STOCKS | Anthropic IPO Filing Discloses Nearly $900 Billion in Off-Balance-Sheet Commitments
data.description: According to Jin10, Anthropic PBC pledged in its IPO filing to spend nearly $900 billion on servers, buildings, power and other items through future obligations as it accelerates infrastructure expansion. The amount far exceeds the liabilities listed on its balance sheet and directly visible to investors. Investors must read the notes to Anthropic’s financial statements to see details of its planned spending; the off-balance-sheet obligations include future lease contracts and purchase agreements for data centers, power and GPUs. David Trainer, CEO of investment research firm New Constructs, said Anthropic’s commitments of this kind are enormous. “They have to invest huge sums in training, inference and energy,” he said.

data.title: Pendle Launches Second Morpho Vault With 9.58% Annualized Yield
data.description: Pendle has launched its second ecosystem vault on Morpho, targeting higher-yield PTs. According to Odaily, Pendle said on X that deposits in USDC will be allocated automatically to higher-yield PT markets. The strategy is supported by recurring demand for PTs and is intended to add liquidity to them; the vault’s annualized deposit yield is 9.58%.

data.title: China's Official Manufacturing PMI at 49.3 in October, Below the 50 Forecast and Prior 50.1
data.description: According to Jin10, China's official manufacturing PMI was 49.3 in October, compared with an expected 50 and a previous reading of 50.1.
